headlines.title: Bill Harris Launches AI Financial Advice App
headlines.summary: The former PayPal and Intuit CEO’s new self-directed platform aims to democratize wealth management strategies for investors without requiring minimum balances.

headlines.title: How Far Could PayPal Stock Fall While Its Turnaround Plays Out?
headlines.summary: PayPal (PYPL) stock has fallen 14.2% over the past month to about $52, and it is still up 23.6% over three months. The bigger question is how far PayPal falls when a real market shock arrives, and how long it stays down. Its record says further than the market. Its turnaround asks for a long wait.

headlines.title: Chesapeake Bank and Reading Cooperative Bank Partner with Rebolt to Launch First Bank-Owned Payment Utility for Small Business
headlines.summary: Built from the ground up by and for community financial institutions, Rebolt brings PayPal, Venmo, stablecoin networks, and instant payments to business customers - inside the bank platforms they already use, making direct payments quicker and easier than ever.

headlines.title: Maye Musk talks bankrolling Elon's first tech startup
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi sits down with model and author Maye Musk to discuss her incredible journey of escaping an abusive marriage and raising three highly successful children, including Elon Musk.

headlines.title: Can PayPal World Drive Deeper Customer Engagement?
headlines.summary: PayPal World is gaining traction as PYPL seeks to boost transaction activity, deepen engagement and drive monetization across its ecosystem.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
